entities.summary: Randall Lee Gibson was an American attorney and politician, elected as a member of the House of Representatives and U.S. senator from Louisiana. He served as a brigadier general in the Confederate States Army. Later he was a regent of the Smithsonian Institution, and a president of the board of administrators of Tulane University.
